meta.title: MiniEncoder: A Small Transformer Encoder for Sentiment Classification

questions.text: How can we effectively classify sentiment in short text sequences using a compact Transformer model?
questions.goal: To develop a minimal Transformer encoder for binary sentiment classification.
questions.source_text: We present MiniEncoder, a compact Transformer-encoder model for binary sentiment classification of short text sequences.

questions.text: What is the architecture of the MiniEncoder model?
questions.goal: To detail the components and structure of the MiniEncoder.
questions.source_text: Given an input sequence of token ids of length up to 128.

questions.text: What dataset is used for training the MiniEncoder?
questions.goal: To describe the dataset characteristics and preprocessing steps.
questions.source_text: The model is trained on a binary sentiment classification dataset of short movie-review-style text snippets.

questions.text: What training procedure is followed for the MiniEncoder?
questions.goal: To outline the training process including loss, optimizer, and hyperparameters.
questions.source_text: Loss: cross-entropy loss over the 2 output logits.

questions.goal: To specify the evaluation metrics and results.
questions.source_text: We report classification accuracy and F1 score on the held-out test split.

methods.name: MiniEncoder
methods.description: A compact Transformer encoder model for binary sentiment classification.
methods.architecture: Two Transformer encoder layers with multi-head self-attention and mean pooling.
methods.source_text: MiniEncoder is designed as a minimal, easy-to-reproduce reference implementation of the encoder-only Transformer pattern.

method_steps.source_text: Text is lowercased, tokenized with a simple whitespace/punctuation tokenizer, and mapped to ids.

method_steps.description: Train the MiniEncoder model using cross-entropy loss and Adam optimizer.
method_steps.schedule: linear warmup over the first 10% of training steps, then linear decay to 0
method_steps.notes: Padding positions are masked out of the self-attention computation.
method_steps.source_text: Loss: cross-entropy loss over the 2 output logits.

method_steps.description: Evaluate the trained MiniEncoder model on the test dataset using accuracy and F1 score.

method_steps.description: Implement the MiniEncoder model architecture as defined, ensuring all components are correctly integrated.
method_steps.notes: Ensure that the model adheres to the specifications outlined in the architecture definition.
method_steps.source_text: MiniEncoder embeds input tokens, adds sinusoidal positional encodings, applies two Transformer encoder layers with multi-head self-attention, and pools the sequence into a single label.
